voiceScript: A stranger may be able to buy a profile built from your personal information. Data Brokers means companies that collect details from records, apps, purchases, and websites, combine them into profiles, and sell or share them. Picture this: a stranger buys a report containing someone's old addresses, relatives, and interests. Here is why that matters: the profile can support targeted scams or expose private information.
